boundary.exact_k0: not covered; use the separately certified homogeneous bridge
boundary.remaining_physical_question: derive/project the early-time finite-k preferred adiabatic source state and its algebraic B seed before coupled Boltzmann feedback

exact_identities.C_reg: 3 a^2 delta_mu_N + 9 H a q_N + 2 H L chi - 3 a^2 Pcal a1_eff (deltaH0_N-H0_prime chi)
exact_identities.Rreg_identity: R_reg=-r*C_reg after D=2+3r and rho_total_prime=-3 H W_total

newtonian_representation.interpretation: the detached first-order chi equation is generated by coordinate/source elimination; its integration constant is not by itself evidence for an extra propagating scalar

non_claims: no numerical chi_initial value is selected
no claim that chi=0 is the physical adiabatic seed
no proof yet of uniqueness of the complete early-time adiabatic gradient expansion
no completed-U1 CLASS feedback or spectra

preferred_coordinate_DAE.A_constraint: psi=-(3/2) a^2 deltaH0_pref/(k^2+a^2 M_c^2) in native CLASS units
preferred_coordinate_DAE.Hamiltonian: phi is algebraic with denominator -(r E_th k^2+2 D H^2)
preferred_coordinate_DAE.conclusion: for every finite k>0 in the certified domain, B is an algebraic constraint variable and requires no independent temporal initial datum once the preferred source state is specified
preferred_coordinate_DAE.psi_prime: K_prime deltaH0_pref + K deltaH0_pref_prime; no B_prime when preferred sources are fundamental

superhorizon.assumption: C_com:=3 a^2 delta_mu_N+9 H a q_N=k^2 C2+O(k^4), finite chi, finite M_c>0
superhorizon.conclusion: leading regularity makes phi finite for every finite chi and therefore does not select chi_initial
